articles.summary: A user reports that their EV didn’t charge overnight. Support opens the dashboard. The vehicle looks fine now — but what happened hours ago? Asset History gives teams the clarity to find out.
articles.title: Introducing Asset History: a new way to investigate EV charging issues

articles.summary: Iberdrola has long been a frontrunner in clean energy, with one of the world’s largest renewable generation portfolios and a commitment to electrifying society through innovation across the entire energy value chain. As Iberdrola looked to scale, it became clear that hardware alone wasn’t enough. That shift brought Enode into the picture.
articles.title: Iberdrola uses Enode to connect millions to a smarter energy system
